_note: The pet's lines for every Digimon of a stage (PetBrain.stage_key: baby = Fresh and In-Training); his own few (own.json) join them. Rows split at line breaks; at most 3 rows under the name, each must fit DW1's text box (tests: test_pet_lines, tools/check_pet_lines.gd). DW1's font has letters, digits and . , : ; ? ! ' + - = only; two spaces between sentences.
greet:
A new day.  I'll be at
your side.

Good.  You came.
Shall we work?
morning:
Morning.  The early
hours are the calmest.
night:
Night has come.  Don't
push yourself too far.
talk:
We've come a long way
from that first egg.

File City is lively
these days.

Few ever reach this
form.  Thank you.

Patience wins more
fights than power.

Your desk is calm.
I like it here.

Take a break when you
need one.
praise:
Thank you.  I'll stay
worthy of it.
scold_unfair:
I've done nothing to
deserve that.

A lesson with no fault?
How strange.

Hmph.  I'll let that one
go.  Once.
read:
So much knowledge on
this screen.

Hmm.  Ancient writing?
No...  Just yours.
done:
Finished.  A fine
piece of work.
failed:
A stumble.  Rise and
try again.

Not every battle is
won at once.
game:
To File City.  We have
work there too.
hungry:
I am hungry.
A meal, if you would.
toilet:
Pardon me.  I need
the toilet.
trained_enough:
Enough of this one.
Another, perhaps.

This one is done
for today.
evolve_ready:
Even now, I can
still grow stronger!
